note: Quiet-interval labels, one per detector cell-week. Sampling designs included, so the weights are reconstructable from this file alone: the false-alarm rate is a Horvitz–Thompson estimate over the frame, not a count over these rows. Superseded rows retained deliberately.

detector_alerted.predicate:
concat(probe_cc, '|', toString(probe_asn), '|', domain, '|', toString(week)) IN (
    SELECT concat(probe_cc, '|', toString(probe_asn), '|', domain, '|', toString(toStartOfWeek(ts, 1)))
    FROM event_detector_changepoints
    WHERE ts >= %(since)s AND ts < %(until)s AND change_dir > 0
)
